items.title: Trump unveils $200 billion South Korean investment in US; Seoul hedges on Alaska pipeline
items.author: Jarrett Renshaw, Gram Slattery, Trevor Hunnicutt
items.creator: Jarrett Renshaw, Gram Slattery, Trevor Hunnicutt
items.summary: US President Donald Trump unveiled plans on Wednesday for South Korea to invest some $200 billion in US projects, but Seoul quickly suggested one key element, a $54 billion pipeline for an LNG project in Alaska, was not yet set in stone.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump unveiled plans on Wednesday for South Korea to invest some $200 billion in US projects, but Seoul quickly suggested one key element, a $54 billion pipeline for an LNG project in Alaska , was not yet set in stone.
The announcement from the White House amounted to the first set of major projects under a broader [USN:L4N45D0DQ TEXT:"$350 billion strategic investment package"] South Korea made as part of a trade agreement with Washington last year. The package included $150 billion for shipbuilding and $200 billion for strategic investments.
"Thanks to the agreements my administration has secured with the Republic of Korea, they will invest up to $200 billion," Trump said from the Oval Office.
He said the investment would include the construction of eight large-scale nuclear power plants, a natural gas pipeline and a 6-gigawatt power generation facility in Texas.
The announcement is the latest in a series of economic and investment deals Trump is highlighting ahead of November's midterm elections , as he seeks to reinforce his economic record amid voter concerns over the Iran war and high gasoline prices.
The pipeline project could carry political significance in Alaska, where Republican Senator Dan Sullivan faces a competitive reelection race against Democrat Mary Peltola. Sullivan attended Wednesday's announcement.
South Korea's government, however, said the pipeline project would only go forward if certain commercial and legal conditions are met. Seoul confirmed other elements of Trump's announcement, saying it would invest $22.3 billion in a Texas gas power project to power AI data centers, as well as $120 billion to build eight nuclear reactors.
PROJECT LONG IN LIMBO South Korea will begin reviewing the Alaska LNG project to assess its commercial viability and compliance with legal procedures, Seoul's industry ministry said in a statement.
"No decision has been made on whether to invest or on the size of the investment," it said.
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung also said in a post on X that the commercial viability of both the LNG project and the nuclear reactors must be confirmed before they proceed.
Any differences between Seoul and Washington over details of the deal could lead to disputes between the allies over its implementation, analysts in Seoul said.
[USN:L4N45M0CI TEXT:"The Alaska LNG project"], if it ultimately goes forward, includes an 807-mile pipeline carrying natural gas from the North Slope to a liquefaction facility on Alaska's southern coast, allowing the fuel to be shipped to Asian markets. The project is designed to transport about 3.9 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day and produce up to 20 million metric tons of LNG annually, according to the White House.
Trump has repeatedly promoted the project as a way to expand US energy exports and strengthen ties with allies including South Korea and Japan .
But the project has faced years of uncertainty over its cost, financing and commercial viability.
South Korea's industry ministry said last week that a more than 6-gigawatt gas-fired power plant in Encinal, Texas , was the first project selected under the $200 billion strategic investment program.
COMMITMENTS NEED TO BE BINDING Japan's two biggest LNG importers, JERA and Tokyo Gas, have signed preliminary agreements to buy a combined 2 million metric tons a year from Alaska LNG if it is built.
Glenfarne, the project's developer, welcomed Trump's investment announcement. It has lined up commitments for 13 million tons a year, but needs another 3 million tons to support a final investment decision and make commitments binding.
"Glenfarne will work with the US and Korean governments to finalize the investment structure and complete the remaining steps required to reach FID," it said in a statement.
The eight nuclear plants would form part of Trump's effort to expand US nuclear generation as electricity demand rises, including from data centers and manufacturing. South Korea has been discussing a potential investment in US nuclear projects as part of the broader package.
The Texas gas-fired power project is expected to supply electricity to energy-intensive facilities, including semiconductor plants and data centers. South Korean officials have said the project was selected after reviews of its commercial viability.

items.title: 米PCE統計、個人消費が約1年ぶり大幅増－コア価格指数は予想下回る
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 8月の米個人消費支出（PCE）は約1年ぶりの大幅な伸びとなった。根強いインフレに見舞われている経済を力強く支えた。

米連邦準備制度が基調的なインフレ指標として重視する食品とエネルギーを除いたコアPCE価格指数は、予想を下回る前月比0.2％上昇となった。前月分の伸び率も下方修正された。

インフレが高止まりする中でも、米経済は堅調に推移していることが今回のデータに示された。消費者は安定した雇用市場と堅調な株式市場に助けられ、自動車や家具、衣類といった財への支出を増やした。ガソリンをはじめとする全般的なコスト高の影響を乗り越えている。

米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）は9月会合で3年ぶりの利上げに踏み切った。金融政策当局者は追加利上げの時期を見極めようとしており、インフレと支出のデータを注視している。

次回FOMC（10月28日発表）を控え、10月2日に発表される9月の雇用統計はより全体的な経済の姿を明らかにする見通しだ。同統計ではインフレや個人消費に関する新たなデータも発表される。

市場ではFRBが重視するコア価格指数の数値が予想より良好だったとして、10月の利上げ観測が後退したものの、年内の追加利上げは引き続き予想されている。統計発表後の米金融市場では、S&P500種株価指数が上昇した一方、米国債利回りは低下した。

PNCファイナンシャル・サービシズ・グループのチーフエコノミスト、ガス・ファウチャー氏は「現時点では、FRBはひとまず金利を据え置いて様子を見ることができると思う」と話す。「追加利上げは行われるだろうが、FRBは直ちに行動する必要があると考えていないだろう」と述べた。

今回の発表には国内総生産（GDP）と支出、インフレについて過去5年にさかのぼる幅広い年次改定が含まれた。インフレ率の算出方法に関する変更も盛り込まれた。

4－6月（第2四半期）のGDP確報値は季節調整済み年率換算で前期比2.2%増となり、改定値の1.5%増から上方修正された。1－3月（第1四半期）のGDPも上方修正された。

市場ではコア価格指数の数値が予想より良好だったとして、10月利上げ観測が後退したものの、年内の追加利上げは引き続き予想されている。統計発表後の米金融市場では、S&P500種株価指数が上昇した一方、米国債利回りは低下した。

今回の発表には国内総生産（GDP）と支出、インフレについて過去5年にさかのぼる幅広い年次改定が含まれた。インフレ率の算出方法に関する変更も盛り込まれた。

4－6月（第2四半期）のGDP確報値は季節調整済み年率換算で前期比2.2%増となり、改定値の1.5%増から上方修正された。1－3月（第1四半期）のGDPも上方修正された。

改定や算出手法の更新により、ここ数カ月のインフレ率全体の水準は低下したものの、根強い物価上昇圧力が続いている傾向に変わりはない。7月のコア価格指数が前年同月比3.3%上昇から3%上昇に修正され、同指数は3カ月連続で3%上昇となった。

8月の総合PCE価格指数は前年同月比3.4%上昇と、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の目標である2%をなお大きく上回り、修正後の7月の数値と一致した。インフレ率はすでに5年以上にわたり、FRBの目標を上回っている。

items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 9月の米民間雇用者数は市場予想を上回る伸びとなった。米経済が勢いを増しつつある兆候が新たに示された。

雇用増の半分余りを教育・医療サービス分野が占めた。娯楽・ホスピタリティーや建設、製造業でも堅調な伸びが示された。

安定した労働市場と底堅い個人消費を背景に、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は根強いインフレの抑制に向けた取り組みに注力できている。

ADPのチーフエコノミスト、ネラ・リチャードソン氏は発表文で「力強い内容だ」と指摘。「過去3カ月にわたる減速を経て雇用創出は持ち直した。賃金の伸びも堅調さを維持した」と分析した。

転職した労働者の賃金は前年同月比7.3%上昇。同じ職場にとどまった労働者の賃金上昇率は同4.4%で横ばいだった。

10月2日に発表される9月の米雇用統計では、公的部門も含めた非農業部門雇用者数が、前月比9万人増になると市場では見込まれている。

原題：US Companies

items.title: Flydubai 'terrorist' wanted to crash plane, kill Israelis: Security minister
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Saudi Arabia has arrested the co-pilot who allegedly stabbed the other pilot and tried to crash the flydubai plane.
items.body:
Advertisement

Flydubai 'terrorist' wanted to crash plane, kill Israelis: Security minister

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Saudi Arabia has arrested the co-pilot who allegedly stabbed the other pilot and tried to crash the flydubai plane.

Passengers queue at the flydubai counters in Ben Gurion Airport near Tel Aviv on Sep 30, 2026. (Photo: AFP/Jack Guez)

JERUSALEM: The emergency landing of a Tel Aviv-bound flydubai flight on Wednesday (Sep 30) was due to a "terrorist" who wanted to crash the plane and kill Israelis, AFP reported, citing Israel's national security minister.
"The naive notion that our enemies cherish life and that we should pity them received another reminder this morning in the form of a terrorist who planned to crash a plane and murder the 180 Israelis on board," Itamar Ben Gvir said in a statement.
Two pilots were wounded after they reportedly fought on board the plane they were flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv, and which was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday.
Reuters reported two Israeli officials as saying that the co-pilot was believed to have stabbed the captain before cabin crew entered the cockpit and took control of the plane.

The two officials, speaking on the condition of anonymity to brief reporters, said Israel's current assessment is that the incident was an attempted "terror attack" and not related to any kind of mental health issue with either of the pilots.
The co-pilot has since been arrested and is currently being interrogated by the Saudi authorities, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in a video message, as he ordered preparations against further possible threats.

The flydubai plane landed in Tabuk at 9.45am (2.45pm, Singapore time) and "its captain and co-pilot were found to have injuries and were transported to hospital", a statement from the company operating the airport said.
The low-cost carrier had earlier said flight FZ1073 "experienced an incident while en route". 
Around the time the plane landed in Saudi Arabia, Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for the Israeli prime minister's office, told Reuters the incident was not believed to have been a hijacking, describing it as a "different incident".
He did not immediately respond to a further request for comment on whether Israel was treating it as terror incident.
The incident triggered national security consultations in Israel, which has no official diplomatic relations with Saudi Arabia, where the plane landed. 
In a statement, the Israeli prime minister's office said the situation was "under control" and that all measures were being taken to bring the Israeli passengers back to Israel.
Netanyahu, who earlier held security consultations on the incident, has cleared his schedule for the rest of the day to manage the crisis, an Israeli official said.

A screengrab taken from Flightradar24 shows a flydubai flight to Israel which was diverted to Saudi Arabia on Sep 30, 2026. (Image: Flightradar24.com/Handout via Reuters)

Related:

Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says

"A LOT OF BLOOD" At Ben Gurion airport near Tel Aviv, families gathered to await the return of their loved ones.
Yasmin Abukasis, mother of passenger Miryam Shira Ohayon, told AFP her daughter called her from Saudi Arabia: "She said one pilot tried to kill the other pilot with a knife. They heard shouting".
Another passenger went to the cockpit "and saw a lot of blood. She started screaming 'come help' and some people went in and caught the guy", she added.
She added that two other pilots in the back later took over the controls.
Meir Zohar, the father of passenger Ido Zohar, told AFP his son had told him by text message that he was well, but that he had no other news.
"We heard on the news what happened in the sky of Abu Dhabi," he said.
"He told us that everything is okay, he didn't tell me that much."
Israeli media, citing anonymous sources, reported that passengers on board had stepped in to separate the two pilots during their altercation, publishing photos of a passenger with a bloodied T-shirt.
Channel 12 reported that authorities were investigating whether or not one of the pilots had attempted a possible suicide by trying to crash the plane, with the other pilot apparently intervening to prevent the crash.

According to data from the Flightradar website, the aircraft suddenly lost altitude during the flight, dropping from nearly 34,000 feet to less than 17,000 feet in less than 30 seconds.

Source: Agencies/aj

items.title: トルコ証券不正疑惑、ノルウェー政府系ファンドが渦中の企業に投資
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ノルウェーの政府系ファンドは、トルコで拡大する相場操縦捜査の対象となっている企業に約20億クローネ（約330億円）相当投資していた。

2兆3000億ドル（約361兆円）の運用資産を抱える世界最大級の政府系ファンド、ノルウェー政府年金基金グローバルの運営主体であるノルウェー中央銀行投資管理部門（NBIM）は、同部門のウェブサイトに6月30日付で公表されたデータに基づくと、トルコの検察当局または規制当局が今回の事件との関連を指摘した10社の株式を保有していた。

当時この10社の株式は、NBIMが保有していた204億クローネのトルコ株の約10%に相当したが、その後、広範な捜査が進む中で価値は急落した。

トルコの検察当局は、投資ファンドが流動性の低い銘柄を大量に買い集めて株価を不正につり上げた疑いがあるとして、調べを進めている。捜査対象となっている複数のファンドは、NBIMも投資していた銘柄に大量の株式を保有していた。提出文書によると、NBIMは疑惑の渦中にある投資会社、テラ・ヤティリム・メンクル・デエルエルの株式も購入していた。

NBIMの広報担当者は、現在もこれらの株式を保有しているかどうかについてコメントを控えた。広報担当者によると、NBIMは保有資産を年2回公表しており、その間の保有状況の変化についてはコメントしない。

10社の大半は6月30日以降、大きく売られている。このうち、イスタンブールを拠点とする電気機器メーカーのアストル・エネルジの2%株がNBIMにとって最大の投資先だが、同社株価は今月に入り41%下落した。

items.title: Burundi to take third-country deportees from US
items.author: Clement Manirabarusha
items.creator: Clement Manirabarusha
items.summary: Burundi has agreed to join a clutch of other African nations in receiving migrants from other countries deported from the US under President Donald Trump's hardline immigration policy.
items.body:
Burundi has agreed to join a clutch of [USN:L6N42F03C TEXT:"other African nations"] in receiving migrants from other countries deported from the US under President Donald Trump's hardline immigration policy.
However, Bujumbura will only accept those not accused of crime or terrorism links, said Nancy Ninette Mutoni, spokesperson for President Evariste Ndayishimiye.
Tuesday's announcement gave no details of numbers, timing, or financial details.
Washington has sent so-called third-country deportees to some half a dozen African nations under opaque deals that Senate Democrats say have cost tens of millions of dollars.
In many cases, deportees had secured legal protections from immigration courts in the US against repatriation. But rights groups say the third-country deals allow the US to circumvent those protections.
Mutoni said preparations were underway to arrange accommodation, living conditions and integration into communities. "Receiving them requires serious planning — where they will stay, what they will eat and how they will live alongside the local population," she said.
"If they choose to join Burundian citizens and make a valuable contribution to national development, the law will be respected," she said, regarding potential citizenship.
Burundi aimed to both strengthen diplomatic relations and provide hospitality to people in need, the spokesperson added.
The US State Department told Reuters in an email late on Wednesday that it does "not comment on the details of our private diplomatic communications with other governments," while a spokesperson for the Burundi foreign ministry said on Wednesday that the details of the agreement were not yet available.

items.summary: Filmmaker Danny Boyle has confirmed that the third instalment of the ‘28 Years Later’ franchise is in development, revealing that the upcoming film will feature a significant presence of actor Cillian ...
items.body:
Danny Boyle backs Jack O’Connell for James Bond, confirms Cillian Murphy’s return in '28 Years Later Part 3' Filmmaker Danny Boyle has confirmed that the third instalment of the ‘28 Years Later’ franchise is in development, revealing that the upcoming film will feature a significant presence of actor Cillian Murphy, Variety reported.

Danny Boyle (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

Key Takeaways

Filmmaker Danny Boyle has confirmed that the third instalment of the ‘28 Years Later’ franchise is in development, revealing that the upcoming film will feature a significant presence of actor Cillian Murphy, Variety reported. Speaking at the Zurich Film Festival, where he presented his film ‘Ink’, Boyle said the next chapter in the post-apocalyptic franchise will be made, though the exact timeline remains undecided.
“‘28 Years 3,’ or whatever it ends up being called, will get made because people keep asking about it. Quite when I’m not sure, but there’s a script – a very good script by Alex Garland,” Boyle said. Talking about Murphy’s involvement, Boyle revealed, “It will have a lot of Cillian Murphy in it. Whether he’ll take his kit off anymore, that I don’t know. He’s got the Oscar now.”
Recalling Murphy’s appearance in the original 2002 film ‘28 Days Later’, Boyle said he was surprised by the actor’s physique. “He’s gorgeous. When we took his kit off, I couldn’t believe it. He looked like Iggy Pop! Everything was glistening. Oh my God. He’s just one of those people. He doesn’t work out or anything like that: he just looks like that,” he said, according to Variety.
During the festival, Boyle also shared his thoughts on the search for the next James Bond actor, backing his ‘Ink’ star Jack O’Connell for the iconic role. “They should cast Jack O’Connell as Bond,” Boyle said.
Boyle had previously exited the James Bond film ‘No Time to Die’ after creative differences over the direction of the project. “When they asked me to do Bond, we came up with the story [with John Hodge] and they lost confidence in it. It’s a shame, because it could have been really good,” he said, according to Variety.
However, Boyle expressed confidence in filmmaker Denis Villeneuve, who is set to direct the next Bond film. “Villeneuve is amazing. Did you see that beginning of ‘Dune: Part Three’, which they showed before ‘The Odyssey’? God, if I was directing ‘The Odyssey’, I would have thought everybody would be disappointed in my film following it. But obviously, Chris Nolan has more confidence than I have,” he said.
Boyle also praised O’Connell’s performance in ‘Ink’, where the actor portrays Larry Lamb in the biographical drama based on James Graham’s stage play about the launch of The Sun newspaper under Rupert Murdoch. “Have you seen ‘Back to Black’? It’s a wonderful film. He plays the boyfriend and that’s an impossible part. It was an incredible performance,” Boyle said, as per the outlet.
“I thought he should play Larry Lamb, because he’s weird. Despite the fact that he’s playing a monster, you’re still interested in him. You’re still intrigued by him and he doesn’t repel you,” he added. Reflecting on the character of Murdoch in ‘Ink’, Boyle said he wanted to present a different perspective rather than rely on existing perceptions.
“People are fascinated by him, and repelled by him, but this comes from a time when he first arrived in the U.K. and was a very different figure. I thought it’s really interesting not to play into the caricature of him, because back at the beginning, he wasn’t like that at all. He’s quite a prudish man, weirdly,” he said. Boyle also discussed the changing relationship between society and information, saying the film explores how modern conversations around truth and media developed over time.
“We have lost our relationship with the truth, and by that I mean our dependable relationship with the truth,” he said. “We’ve replaced it with — and the most powerful man in the world is the best example of it — with brazen assertions and loud stories, and completely counter-intuitive declarations,” Boyle added, according to Variety.
The filmmaker said that while social and political changes can be challenging, he believes progress remains possible. “You have to look for those sprouts of hope,” Boyle said. (ANI)

items.title: "He took care of me... I love him so much": John Goodman recalls bond with Bruce Willis
items.summary: Veteran actor John Goodman reflected on his decades-long friendship with Bruce Willis, recalling their early days as struggling actors in New York and praising the Hollywood star for supporting him at ...
items.body:
"He took care of me... I love him so much": John Goodman recalls bond with Bruce Willis Veteran actor John Goodman reflected on his decades-long friendship with Bruce Willis, recalling their early days as struggling actors in New York and praising the Hollywood star for supporting him at the beginning of his career, according to People. 
ANI | Updated: 30-09-2026 23:35 IST | Created: 30-09-2026 23:35 IST

John Goodman (Photo/Reuters) . Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Veteran actor John Goodman reflected on his decades-long friendship with Bruce Willis, recalling their early days as struggling actors in New York and praising the Hollywood star for supporting him at the beginning of his career, according to People. Speaking to People at the Los Angeles premiere of ‘Digger’, Goodman, 74, recalled meeting Willis around the time he landed his breakthrough role in the 1980s television series ‘Moonlighting’.
“I remember when he got the Moonlighting job, and we were at the bar where he used to work at, and we all hung out at, and he jumped over a railing. I think he broke my shoulder, but he was so happy,” Goodman said. The actor said their conversations often revolved around acting and their shared passion for the craft.
“That’s all we did was talk about acting when we were at work, when we were out goofing around. I could tell how serious he was. I started working out here [in LA] about a year or two later after he did,” he added. Recalling Willis’ support during his early years, Goodman said, “He took care of me…I love him so much.”
Goodman, who previously guest-starred in an episode of ‘Moonlighting’, said he has not met Willis in some time, mainly because he no longer lives in Los Angeles. Willis’ family announced in March 2022 that he was stepping away from acting after being diagnosed with aphasia, a condition that later progressed to frontotemporal dementia (FTD).
Goodman has often spoken about his friendship with Willis over the years. The two actors also shared screen space in the 2017 action-comedy film ‘Once Upon a Time in Venice’. Speaking in an interview in 2012, Goodman recalled their time as young actors chasing opportunities in New York during the 1980s.
“Bruce Willis was a bartender at a place I used to go,” Goodman had said, according to People. He further praised Willis’ skills behind the bar, saying, “He was a great bartender; it was a performance every night. He just had the crowd in the palm of his hand. Ah, Bruce, he was great. He got me the drinks and I drank ‘em down.”
Goodman had also previously told the New York Post that he first met Willis in 1979, when Willis worked as a bartender at Chelsea Central on the Upper West Side, a venue that has since closed. “Bruce was the best bartender in New York … He kept an entire joint entertained all night. He just kept the show going. He was amazing,” Goodman said in 2017.
Bruce Willis rose to global fame with projects including ‘Die Hard’ and ‘Moonlighting’, while Goodman has been recognised for his performances in ‘Roseanne’ and several acclaimed films, according to People. (ANI)

items.title: AI関連資産に「急激な調整」のリスク－英中銀が警告
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は30日の金融安定報告で、AI関連資産のバリュエーションが、7月に起きた以上の「急激な調整」に見舞われる可能性が引き続きあり、こうした急落が世界の成長や国債利回りに広範な影響を及ぼす可能性があると警告した。

イングランド銀は、金融システム内で相互に関連するぜい弱性が高まっており、複数のリスクが同時に顕在化する可能性が増していると指摘した。

数兆ドル規模のAI市場は、主要なリスク要因の一つだ。イングランド銀は「中東での戦闘激化」もリスクとみており、「世界経済に対するより長期化した負の供給ショック」につながり、ひいては国債を巡るリスクを高める可能性があるとした。

イングランド銀はこれまでも、AI関連株やクレジット市場、国債などで資産バブルが形成される可能性について繰り返し警告してきた。

前回の金融安定報告後、AI株は開発が減速する可能性への懸念から、激しく変動した。株式市場全般でもボラティリティーが高まり、スマートリングメーカーのオーラなどが、新規株式公開（IPO）を延期する事態となった。

イングランド銀は、7月に起きたAI関連株の下落について「積み上がっていたポジションの巻き戻しと、それに伴うレバレッジの縮小」によって増幅されたと指摘する一方、「中核的な市場への波及はなかった」と強調した。

各国経済の成長見通しは現在、AIが生産性を押し上げるとの期待に部分的に依存している。このため、「そうした期待が見直されれば、AI関連資産のバリュエーションだけでなく、国債市場にも影響を及ぼす可能性がある」との見方を示した。

ベイリー総裁は、イングランド銀ウェブサイトで30日に公表した記事で、AIは金融安定に「重要な影響」を及ぼすと指摘した。また、サイバー脅威のリスクを最小限に抑えるため、AIの能力や機能を「厳格に検証する」ことが重要だと強調した。

ベイリー氏は、「時間の経過とともに、より正式な規制の枠組みが形成される可能性は十分にある」としたうえで、「ただ、規制から始めるのは適切ではない。まず理解し、検証し、信頼できる介入手段を確立する必要がある」との考えを示した。

items.title: S&P 500 Earnings Growth Is Built on Unsustainable Foundations
items.author: Jonathan Levin
items.creator: Jonathan Levin
items.summary: Has the stock market bubble quietly burst already? Even though the S&P 500 Index has mostly treaded water for the past four months, Wall Street analysts have continued to boost their earnings estimates. This has left the benchmark trading at some its cheapest levels of recent years based on the so-called forward price-earnings, or P/E, ratio. And yet, it’s hard to call stocks a bargain, mostly because it’s “E” and not the “P” that looks increasingly unsustainable.

items.title: 直近1カ月の為替介入はゼロ､日銀利上げペース加速観測などで円高進行
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 財務省は30日、直近1カ月の為替介入額はゼロ円だったと公表した。9月上旬には急速に円高方向に振れる場面も見られたが、日本の通貨当局による市場介入はなかった。

財務省は8月27日から9月28日までの実績値を発表した。円相場は2日に対ドルで160円39銭を付けた後、急上昇。8日には152円89銭と2月以来の高値水準を付けた。

7月末の日米協調介入を受けた円の上昇分は、9月初めまでにほぼ巻き戻されていた。片山さつき財務相は当時、為替市場に対して「協調介入の瞬間と同じ姿勢で臨んでいる」と発言。三村淳財務官は、引き続き臨戦態勢だと述べるなど、市場では再度の介入への警戒感が強まっていたが、通貨当局に動きはなかった。

9月上旬の円高の背景には、日本銀行の金融政策や年金基金を巡る思惑があった。利上げに前向きな日銀の高田創審議委員が、一般論としながらも連続利上げや利上げ幅拡大の可能性を示唆。ベッセント米財務長官は、日銀の利上げに強い期待を示した。年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（GPIF）の資産構成の変更を巡る観測も円買いを後押しした。

政府・日銀は4－5月に約11.7兆円、8月26日までの1カ月間に約15.4兆円の円買い介入を実施している。

items.title: 高市政権の脱・補正予算、税収見積もり精緻化を－諮問会議で民間議員
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 経済財政諮問会議の有識者は30日、近年は当初予算段階より上振れする例が多かった税収見積もりを精緻化するよう提言した。概算要求総額が過去最大となった来年度予算編成では、税収でどこまで財源を確保できるかが課題だ。

高市早苗政権では、補正予算に頼らず、必要な支出を当初予算に盛り込む方針だ。初めて概算要求段階から取り組む来年度予算概算要求の総額は143兆円となった。市場は新規国債発行額を注視しており、税収を従来通り保守的に見積もれば増える可能性がある。一方で上振れを見込んで税収を計算すれば、実績が下回った場合に財政運営に影響が出かねない。

近年は当初予算に加え、秋に経済対策として補正予算を組むことが常態化していた。その財源の一部に充てられていたのが、前年末の見積もりを上回った分の税収だった。2021年度以降、5年連続で補正時に税収は上振れた。実績も、5年連続で当初の見積もりを上回っている。

25年度は当初予算編成時に77兆8190億円を見込んでいたが、11月の補正予算編成時には約3兆円上振れると見込み、財源の一部に充てられた。

民間議員が同会議に示した資料では、当初予算編成時の歳入見通しの精度は「これまで以上に重要となる」と指摘。名目国内総生産（GDP）などのマクロ経済や、個別税目の動向、税収実績などを十分に分析するよう求めた。

高市首相は提言を受け、予算編成にあたって「税収動向をより的確に見極めつつ、歳入歳出両面の見直しを進める」と同会議で発言した。また、物価上昇と金利のある経済の下、供給力を強化し強い経済を実現するとも語った。

税収の上振れについて、片山さつき財務相は「足元の課税実績や企業収益の見通しなどを反映」したと説明している。内閣府の担当者は、年度によって要因は異なるものの、所得税のうち金融所得課税や法人税収が上振れることが多いとした。GDPが政府の見通しを上回ったことも背景にある。

items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： ドイツ政府は国営エネルギー会社SEFEに対し、今後数週間で天然ガスを調達し、貯蔵するよう指示した。欧州では冬を前に、異例の低水準にある在庫を積み増す必要性が高まっている。

SEFEは電子メールでの声明で、12月15日までに8テラワット時のガスを貯蔵施設に注入するよう指示されたと明らかにした。ドイツ経済省の報道官は、この措置について「ドイツのガス供給の強靱（きょうじん）性を高めるための重要な追加措置」だと説明した。

イラン戦争の開始以降、ホルムズ海峡がほぼ閉鎖されたことで、欧州などの買い手は代替供給源の確保を迫られている。ドイツのガス貯蔵施設では、この時期としては異例の低水準に在庫が落ち込んでおり、供給混乱が続けば消費者が大幅な価格上昇に直面するとの懸念が高まっている。

items.title: Bank of England sees growing risk that dangers from AI and debt will materialise
items.author: Phoebe Seers, David Milliken
items.creator: Phoebe Seers, David Milliken
items.body:
LONDON, Sept 30 (Reuters) - The Bank of England on Wednesday warned of an increase in the risk that interconnected weaknesses in the financial system will crystallise, highlighting the re-escalation of the conflict in Iran and increased AI-related debt issuance.
Rises in oil and gas prices had led to bond yields increasing to levels not seen since 2008, the BoE's Financial Policy Committee said.
While the financial system and equity markets had so far proved resilient, the FPC warned that the danger of a sharp adjustment persists. It maintained its Countercyclical Capital Buffer – a varying buffer against financial risks - at 2%.
"The likelihood that interconnected vulnerabilities in the financial system crystallise has risen," the FPC said in a record of its quarterly meeting.
"Specifically, the re-escalation of the conflict and the associated rises in oil, gas and refined product prices are leading to a more protracted negative supply shock," it added.
AI RISKS WORRY GOVERNOR BAILEY The FPC is chaired by BoE Governor Andrew Bailey and focuses on financial stability risks.
In an article on AI risks released alongside the FPC record, Bailey expanded on his concerns about risks from frontier AI and stressed the need for "rigorous model testing, conducted both before and after deployment" ahead of tighter regulation.
"Over time, a more formal regulatory framework may well emerge. But regulation is not, in my view, the right place to start. Understanding, testing and establishing credible points of intervention must come first," he wrote.
The "rapid increase" in AI-related debt issuance had also increased the exposure of capital markets to developments in AI, the FPC said.
In early September, Morgan Stanley estimated that global AI-related debt issuance totalled around $450 billion, double that of 2025.
While AI-related and semiconductor stocks had fallen sharply in July, market functioning remained orderly. While valuations remain high, a more significant shock could trigger a sharper repricing, it warned.
A series of incidents has boosted policymakers' concerns about the potential for AI systems to circumvent safeguards, including in July when an OpenAI agent escaped a controlled testing environment and hacked AI company Hugging Face.
"These developments reinforced the Committee's assessment…that advances in AI could increase cyber and operational risks," the BoE said.
TIMELINE SET FOR BANK LEVERAGE AND GILT REPO REFORMS The BoE said it would produce more detailed proposals in early 2027 for changes to bank leverage rules and those governing the gilt repo market, where traders seek to profit from moves in interest rates, and investors turn bond holdings into temporary cash.
In July, the FPC said it would soften the impact of the leverage ratio, which requires lenders to hold a minimum ratio of capital against total assets.
A consultation on these changes will begin early next year, which the BoE said "increases the importance of continuing to develop and implement measures to improve the resilience of the gilt repo market.
In July, Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden said "doing nothing is not an option" for regulating the gilt repo market, due to the continued risk that it causes bond trading to dry up in a financial crisis.
Net borrowing in the gilt repo market totals around £200 billion ($270 billion) according to BoE data, and the central bank said hedge fund leverage had remained high but stable in recent months.
Last year, the BoE set out initial proposals for tighter rules after it had to intervene in 2020 and 2022 at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic and following Prime Minister Liz Truss' mini-budget.
However, the proposals have led to pushback from the finance industry, and Breeden said some reforms such as greater use of central clearing "will likely take years, not months".
(Reporting by Phoebe Seers and David Milliken)
(( david.milliken@thomsonreuters.com ; +44 20 7513 4034))
Keywords: BRITAIN BOE/

items.title: フランスとイタリアでインフレ加速－ECBへの利上げ圧力強まる
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： フランスとイタリアの9月のインフレ率が市場予想を上回り、欧州中央銀行（ECB）に追加利上げを求める圧力が強まった。

仏国立統計経済研究所（INSEE）の30日の発表によると、フランスの9月の物価上昇率は3.4%と、8月の2.6%から上昇した。この約2年で最も高い伸びとなった。イタリアは4.1%と、2023年以来の高水準をつけた。エネルギー価格が引き続き、主な押し上げ要因だった。

7カ月に及ぶイラン戦争による原油と天然ガス高騰の影響は、欧州経済に波及し続けている。ECBは金融政策の引き締めを進め、各国政府はエネルギー料金の上昇に直面する企業や家計への支援を迫られている。

フランスの統計によると、物価上昇圧力の大半が引き続きエネルギーコストに由来している。9月のエネルギー価格は前年同月比21.2%上昇した。二次的な波及効果はまだ表れていないとするECB政策当局者の見方と一致する動きだ。

スペインで29日に発表されたインフレ率は5%と、過去約3年で最も高い伸びとなった。ECBの2%目標の2倍を超える水準だ。

欧州連合（EU）統計局は10月2日、ユーロ圏全体の消費者物価統計を発表する。エコノミストは、総合インフレ率が3.7%と3年ぶりの高水準に達すると予想している。

ECBは今年2回利上げしており、中銀預金金利を2.5%としている。市場は今後1年間で0.25ポイントの利上げをさらに4回近く織り込んでいる。ラガルド総裁は28日、インフレを抑制するため「必要に応じて慎重に対応する」との考えを示した。一方で、世界的な債券売りが物価と成長を抑制するとも警告した。

原題：Inflation Quickens Much More Than Expected in France and Italy（抜粋）

--取材協力：Giovanna Coi、市倉はるみ、Joel Rinneby、Mark Schroers、James Hirai、Rafael Mendes.

Singapore's Temasek to open Riyadh, Abu Dhabi offices in Middle East expansion

The new offices will expand Temasek's global network to 15 offices in 11 countries in 2027. 

A view of investment company Temasek's logo at its Singapore headquarters. (File photo: CNA/Abigail Ng)

FAST

HONG KONG: Singapore state investor Temasek said on Wednesday (Sep 30) it planned to open offices in Riyadh and Abu Dhabi in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals, seeking investment and partnership opportunities across the Middle East.
The new offices will expand Temasek's global network to 15 offices in 11 countries in 2027. Temasek had a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$405.5 billion) as of Mar 31, 2026.
"The Middle East is an important part of Temasek’s global network," Temasek CEO Dilhan Pillay Sandrasegara said in a statement.
"The pace and ambition of economic transformation across the region are remarkable, and its long-term fundamentals remain highly attractive."

The expansion signals Temasek's confidence in the Gulf's long-term growth despite regional tensions that have raised uncertainty for markets, energy supplies and shipping.
The statement said Temasek would deepen engagement across the Middle East, particularly in Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar, where it sees long-term opportunities for itself and its portfolio companies.
Temasek said it would also engage institutions in Qatar and other Middle East markets. The expansion would also strengthen its access to opportunities in Central Asia and Africa, it added.
Chia Song Hwee, CEO of Temasek Global Investments, became chairman for the Middle East and Africa on Sep 1. He will provide senior oversight of Temasek's engagement and long-term growth in the markets, Temasek said.
"Being on the ground in the Middle East will strengthen engagement with our partners and enhance access to investment opportunities for Temasek and our portfolio companies throughout the region and beyond to Central Asia and Africa," Chia said.
"Equally, it allows us to bring complementary expertise from across our ecosystem to these markets, expanding pathways to create lasting value with like-minded partners."
Ankit Khemka will remain managing director for the region and lead Temasek's strategy and expansion.

items.title: シンガポールとマレーシア、大規模なスポーツイベント控え深刻な煙害
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： シンガポールとマレーシアの首都クアラルンプールは、インドネシアの森林火災から流れ込む深刻な煙害に見舞われており、大規模なスポーツイベントを前に大気の状態が急激に悪化している。

IQAirがまとめたデータによると、両都市は現在、世界で大気汚染が深刻な都市ワースト5に入っている。広範囲にわたる乾燥や東から南東に吹く卓越風など、今回の煙害を引き起こしている気象条件は、今後さらに1週間続く見通しだ。

マレーシアでは今週末、セパン・インターナショナル・サーキットで9年ぶりとなる自動車レースの最高峰フォーミュラワン（F1）が開催予定で、クアラルンプールではスタンダードチャータードがスポンサーのマラソン大会も行われる。

刺激臭を伴う煙害により、両イベントに支障が出る可能性がある。マラソン大会の主催者は、状況が悪化した場合に備え、緊急対応策を検討していると明らかにした。F1イベント主催者とセパン・インターナショナル・サーキットは、コメントの要請に直ちに応じなかった。

そうしたシナリオは先週末、シンガポールで現実となった。大気の質が悪化したため、ハーフマラソンの距離が直前に短縮された。

シンガポールではマレーシアに続き、10月9日からF1レースも開催される予定だ。シンガポールグランプリの主催者は、コメントの求めにすぐに返答しなかった。

原題：Singapore, Malaysia Cloaked in Haze Before Key Sports Events (1)　（抜粋）

--取材協力：Andrea Tan、Kok Leong Chan、Netty Idayu Ismail、Anuradha Raghu.

items.title: ニデック、前期6321億円規模の減損損失－不正会計受け資産精査
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニデックは30日、前期（2026年3月期）に約6321億円の減損損失を計上したと発表した。不正会計を受けた資産の精査で、車載や家電事業などの資産価値を見直した。

発表によれば、減損損失のうち2311億円が車載事業に関連するもので、家電・商業・産業用が3351億円となっている。これにより同期の純損益は5646億円の赤字となった。

会計不正を巡っては、これまで25年6月末時点の純資産が1607億円減少するほか、主に車載事業の約2500億円の資産を対象に追加減損が発生する可能性があると説明していた。今回の減損額は、この検討対象資産の規模を大幅に上回った。

同社は今期（27年3月期）営業損益予想について2000億円の黒字の見通しだとした。

新たに提出された前期の財務諸表に対して、監査法人は「意見不表明」とした。

ニデックの株価は、28日の1兆円規模の減損報道を受け株価が一時制限値幅いっぱいのストップ安となり、29日も株価は続落。30日は子会社の売却検討に関する報道や会社側の声明が好感されて反発したものの下落分を取り戻すには至っていない。

ニデックは29日、岸田光哉社長が退任し、後任に最高技術責任者（CTO）も務める戒田理夫専務執行役員が就任する人事も発表していた。巨額減損と不正会計問題への対応が続く中、経営体制も刷新する。

ニデックは25年11月、主要取引銀行である三菱UFJ銀行と三井住友銀行との間で総額6000億円のコミットメントライン契約を締結したと発表。契約期間は26年11月6日までの1年間だが、26年3月期決算期末日の純資産の合計をその前の期末の純資産の75％以上に維持することなどを内容とする財務制限条項が課されていた。

減損により条項に抵触したものの、枠は未使用で銀行側から期限の利益喪失請求権を放棄することで承諾を得ているとした。

巨額減損を経て、次の焦点は上場維持に向けた手続きとなる。ニデックは昨年、不正会計問題を受けて東京証券取引所から特別注意銘柄に指定された。上場廃止となる可能性も出ており、10月までに特別注意銘柄の指定解除に必要な内部管理体制確認書の提出を目指している。新たな減損の計上がこの手続きに影響するかどうかが注目される。

items.title: ニデック、前期6321億円減損－監査法人のお墨付きいまだ得られず
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニデックは30日、前期（2026年3月期）に約6321億円の減損損失を計上したと発表した。不正会計の影響を精査する中で、車載や家電事業などの資産価値を見直すなどした。今期の営業損益は黒字化する見通しを示したが、上場維持には不透明感が残る。

発表によれば、減損損失のうち2311億円が車載事業に関連するもので、家電・商業・産業用が3351億円となっている。ほかに契約損失引当金225億円、仕入れ先からの求償請求の和解に伴う債務42億円、特別調査費用などで305億円を計上。これらにより同期の純損益は5646億円の赤字となった。

同社は今期（27年3月期）営業損益予想について2000億円の黒字の見通しだとした。ブルームバーグがまとめたアナリスト9人の予想平均値（2467億円）を下回る。

新たに提出された前期の財務諸表に対して、監査法人は「意見不表明」とした。監査法人は25年3月期の有価証券報告書には「意見不表明」、前期の半期報告書についても「結論の不表明」としており、お墨付きが得られない状況が続いている。

減損処理を経て、次の焦点は上場維持に向けた手続きとなる。ニデックは昨年、不正会計問題を受けて東京証券取引所から特別注意銘柄に指定された。上場廃止となる可能性も出ており、10月までに特別注意銘柄の指定解除に必要な内部管理体制確認書の提出を目指している。今回の一連の動きがこの手続きに影響するかどうかが注目される。

ニデックを担当するPwCジャパンは30日付の監査報告書で、意見不表明の根拠として、不適切な会計処理への関与や指示、監査法人に虚偽の説明を行った役職員の特定や人事的是正措置が一部完了していないと指摘。問題に関与した可能性のある役職員の一部が、現在もニデックやグループ会社で財務報告を担う責任ある立場にいるとした。PwCジャパンは役職員について特定していない。

items.title: フランス国債リスクプレミアム、14年ぶり高水準－財政や政治を不安視
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 30日の欧州金融市場で、フランス10年国債のドイツ国債に対するリスクプレミアム（上乗せ利回り）が125ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）に達した。利回り差（スプレッド）がこの水準まで拡大するのは2012年半ば以来。

フランス国債は、財政赤字を巡る不安の高まりや債務返済コスト上昇、大統領選を来年4月に控えた政治的不確実性などが圧迫要因となり、売り圧力にさらされている。30日朝に発表されたフランスのインフレ率が予想以上だったことも、利回り上昇を加速させた。

仏国債のドイツ国債に対するスプレッドは、過去4カ月でほぼ倍に拡大し、フランス政府の長期借り入れコストは02年以来の水準に上昇した。

エドモン・ドゥ・ロスチャイルド・アセット・マネジメントのマリー・ジャコ最高経営責任者（CEO）はブルームバーグテレビジョンに対し、この水準は「今朝の債券市場の眠気を吹き飛ばした」と語った。

来年4月18日に第1回投票、上位2人の候補による決選投票が5月2日に実施されるフランスの大統領選を前に、投資家は神経をとがらせている。極右野党・国民連合（RN）から立候補を表明したマリーヌ・ルペン前党首は、過去数カ月にわたり世論調査でトップに立つ。

今週公表された有権者の投票意向調査によれば、ルペン氏と急進左派政党「不屈のフランス」のジャンリュック・メランション氏が決選投票に進むと予想される。

フランスは財政リスクも注意を引いている。フランス国債庁（AFT）は29日遅く、来年の中長期国債の発行額が買い戻し分を差し引いたベースで総額3400億ユーロ（約60兆6500億円）と、過去最大になるとの見通しを示した。政府は10月1日に来年度予算案を発表する予定だ。

最近の世界的な債券安の中にあっても、政治的・財政的な不安定感からフランス債の下げはとりわけ大きい。フランス国債とイタリア国債の10年物利回りスプレッドは22bpと、ユーロ発足以来最大の水準。かつてはポピュリスト政府が欧州連合（EU）の歳出規則を順守せず国債利回りが急騰したイタリアだが、いまやフランスと立場は逆転した。

items.title: 英国のEU再加盟、次期総選挙の争点の可能性も－首相が示唆
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： バーナム英首相は30日朝に放送されたBBCのインタビューで、次期総選挙で欧州連合（EU）再加盟を訴える可能性があると述べ、EU離脱を決めた国民投票から10年を経て、欧州大陸との関係に関する国内の議論を促す意向を示した。

バーナム氏は年内に予定されている英国・EU首脳会談で議論する三つの選択肢として、EU再加盟、EU単一市場への再参加、関税同盟への参加を示した。バーナム氏の発言以前から、EUと英国は11月にブリュッセルで首脳会談を行う準備を進めている。

2016年の国民投票以来、英国の首相がEU復帰に向けた可能性を示唆したのはこれが初めて。バーナム氏は29日、労働党大会での基調演説で、EU離脱はうまくいっていないと主張したが、30日の発言はさらに踏み込んだ内容となった。

フランスのマクロン大統領は30日、スペインのサンチェス首相とマドリードで会見し、バーナム氏の発言に対し、英語で「お帰りなさい」と冗談交じりに語った。

サンチェス氏も、英国のEU離脱は英EU双方にとって「大きな損失」だったと述べ、英国が復帰するなら、スペインは再び「両手を広げて」歓迎すると強調した。

EUの行政執行機関・欧州委員会の報道官は「英国はEUにとって緊密かつ重要なパートナーだ」としたうえで、「今後EUとの関係をどのように発展させたいのかを示すのは英国政府だ」とコメントした。

英国家統計局（ONS）が30日発表した4－6月の国内総生産（GDP）は前期比0.5%増加し、速報値の0.4%増から上方改定された。1－3月は0.6%増だった。

これにより、英国は1－6月に主要7カ国（G7）で最も高い成長率を記録し、市場予想を大幅に上回ったことが確認された。中東での戦争を背景にインフレ圧力が再燃する中でも、消費者は夏場を通じて支出を続けたもようだ。1－6月のGDPは1.2%増と、2024年以来の高い伸びとなった。

items.title: Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Aircraft data appeared to show the plane had suddenly and rapidly descended by nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds before emergency signals were transmitted.
items.body:

Israel-bound flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after brawl between pilots, Israeli official says

Aircraft data appeared to show the plane had suddenly and rapidly descended by nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds before emergency signals were transmitted.

A FlyDubai Boeing 737 MAX 8 airplane at Dubai Airport (DXB) in the United Arab Emirates on Feb 17, 2024. (File photo: iStock/Boarding1Now)

JERUSALEM: Passengers on a flydubai flight reached Israel safely on Wednesday (Sep 30) after customers and crew foiled a co-pilot's attempt to crash the aircraft, Israeli officials said, in a struggle that began when he stabbed the pilot and sent the jet plunging nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds.
Passengers and crew entered the cockpit, overpowered the co-pilot and enabled a second pair of flydubai pilots who were aboard the flight to land the jet safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, Israeli officials said.
More than 10 hours later, the passengers arrived at Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion Airport aboard a flydubai replacement aircraft, with several describing the episode as a miracle and recounting a frantic struggle to prevent a catastrophe.
Israeli officials said the attacker's motive aboard flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv remained under investigation. Israel and the United Arab Emirates, which includes Dubai, signed the Abraham Accords normalizing relations in 2020.

The incident sharpened concerns about global aviation security in a region scarred by years of conflict, prompting Israel to tighten checks on pilots flying into the country.
"I just can say that it was a miracle. It was awful, crazy, and we thank God that we survived it, we didn't think we will make it but thank God we are in Israel. We are back home. And we are happy to see everyone here," passenger Lital Shachaf said.
Israel's ambulance service said a 51-year-old man was taken to an Israeli hospital to be treated for injuries to his upper body. The man was in a "mild condition," it said.
Describing the event as "a serious security incident," Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Saudi authorities would interrogate the co-pilot.
Flydubai said in a statement that the underlying reasons for the event remained unknown and warned against "premature speculation." An Israeli official identified the co-pilot as an Omani national. There was no immediate comment from Oman.
Israeli officials applauded the passengers, who they credited with avoiding a much more serious disaster. Netanyahu said there were 174 people on board the flight from Dubai, most of them Israeli nationals.

"SOMETHING YOU DO WITHOUT THINKING" A Netanyahu spokesperson told Reuters that the wounded captain, identified by the Israeli leader's office as Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, was covered with blood on the floor when he managed to click the release to open the cockpit door. Passengers who entered found the co-pilot bashing at the plane's control panel, the spokesperson said. “This is something you do without thinking, just running to save your daughter’s life, your family’s life,” said Asaf Rajuan, one of the passengers who helped restrain the attacker. He spoke with a forehead still bloodied from the struggle.
Netanyahu's office released a video showing the prime minister at Ben Gurion Airport giving a hug to another passenger, Yaniv Hayun, who his office said "broke into" the cockpit. "I see you and I see a lion - a big hero," Netanyahu told the man, who was still wearing the blood-stained shirt he had on during the flight.
Flydubai operates daily return flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv, a route that is popular among Israeli nationals. The flight path normally uses airspace over Saudi Arabia and Jordan.
It is not the first time a flight between Israel and the UAE has landed in Saudi Arabia. A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Riyadh in September 2025 due to a medical incident, Israeli media reported at the time.
Saudi Arabia's Tabuk airport, where the plane landed, said both pilots had been hospitalised after sustaining injuries.
The incident heightened security fears in Israel weeks before Israelis vote in the first election since the Hamas-led Oct 7, 2023, attacks, with Israel's security figuring prominently in the campaigning.
Responding to the incident on X, far-right security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir wrote, "Terrorism is a devil with whom no agreement must be reached".

ISRAEL TO TIGHTEN CHECKS ON PILOTS FLYING TO ISRAEL Israeli media published conflicting reports on the incident, with some outlets reporting that a pilot had tried to crash the passenger plane in an alleged suicide attempt. Some Israeli media outlets initially identified the pilots as Omani and Emirati nationals, while others said they were Russian and Ukrainian.
"Every pilot that is going to be flying into Israel, we are going to know the pilots' identities, know who they are, and do some type of security check," Doron Spielman, a Netanyahu spokesperson, told Reuters.
Netanyahu met on Sunday with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan during a rare visit to the Gulf country. Israel and the UAE have forged close security, military and economic ties since establishing diplomatic ties.
Israel provided the UAE earlier this year with Iron Dome air-defence systems and Israeli personnel to operate them, helping defend against Iranian attacks launched after Israel and the US began strikes on Iran.
The UAE government had yet to comment on the flydubai incident, while the Dubai state-owned airline said an "altercation" occurred in the cockpit and the flight subsequently diverted to Tabuk, where it landed safely. The UAE's aviation regulator, the GCAA, said the flight "experienced a security incident that was brought under control".

items.title: flydubai co-pilot stabs captain onboard: Here's what we know so far
items.summary: A fight broke out between the pilots onboard a flydubai flight, which prompted the aircraft to divert to Saudi Arabia. Here's what we know about the incident so far ...
items.body:
Home / World News / flydubai co-pilot stabs captain onboard: Here's what we know so far

flydubai co-pilot stabs captain onboard: Here's what we know so far A fight broke out between the pilots onboard a flydubai flight, which prompted the aircraft to divert to Saudi Arabia. Here's what we know about the incident so far

(Representative image from file)

Akshita Singh New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Sep 30 2026 | 6:45 PM IST

Listen to This Article

A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia on Wednesday after an altercation between the pilots turned violent. The aircraft landed safely at Tabuk Airport, with all passengers accounted for.
  The incident involved flight FZ1073 , which departed Dubai International Airport for Ben-Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv. Flight-tracking data showed the aircraft transmitting an emergency code before switching to a code used for unlawful interference. It later returned to the general emergency code and diverted to Tabuk.
  Ever since the incident made headlines, details about what happened onboard have remained conflicting.
  News agency Reuters , citing two Israeli officials, reported that the Israeli government believes the incident may have been an attempted “terror attack” by one of the pilots. Some Israeli media reports identified the pilot under investigation as an Omani national, while other reports gave different nationalities.
 

What happened on the flight? Here’s what we know According to The Jerusalem Post , Israeli officials said one of the pilots stabbed the other during an altercation and attempted to take control of the aircraft. An Israeli official told the newspaper that additional crew members, assisted by passengers, subdued the pilot.
Also Read

  The Jerusalem Post reported that the aircraft lost about 4,000 metres in altitude during the incident. Flightradar24 's flight data shows that the aircraft began a steep descent at about 05:21 UTC (10:51 am IST), after flying at around 34,000 feet. It later levelled off at about 15,000 feet before continuing towards Tabuk.

  Passengers told Israel's Channel 12 that they heard shouting from the front of the aircraft and that the plane dipped sharply before landing in Saudi Arabia.
Reports about the pilot's nationality The identity and background of the pilot involved in the incident were still being investigated, according to The Jerusalem Post . The newspaper reported that initial Israeli investigations indicated that the suspected pilot was believed to be an Omani national.
  Notably, Oman does not have diplomatic relations with Israel.
  According to a Transportation Ministry source cited by The Jerusalem Post , flydubai's agreement allowing it to operate flights to and from Ben-Gurion Airport requires pilots to be from countries that have normalised relations with Israel.

  The Jerusalem Post reported that Israeli Transport Minister Miri Regev had asked Shin Bet to halt flydubai flights entering and leaving Israel following the unconfirmed reports about the pilot's Omani origin. The nationality had not been independently confirmed at the time of writing this report.
What flydubai has said flydubai confirmed that flight FZ1073 had "experienced an incident while en route" and said the aircraft landed safely at Tabuk Airport.
  The airline said: "All passengers are safe and accounted for. The safety and wellbeing of our passengers and crew remain our highest priority. Our teams are working closely with the relevant authorities. Further updates will be issued as additional confirmed details become available."

  Tabuk airport also said that both the pilot and first officer were wounded and were taken to hospital after the aircraft landed. It did not give details on how the injuries occurred.
Passengers to return to Israel Israel said arrangements were being made to bring the passengers back from Saudi Arabia. The Prime Minister's Office said: "The incident is under control, and all measures are currently being deployed in order to return the Israeli passengers safely to Israel."
  The Jerusalem Post reported that flydubai planned to send another aircraft to Saudi Arabia to take the passengers back to Tel Aviv.
  The airline has not publicly provided further details about the incident beyond confirming that it occurred and that the passengers were safe.

items.title: 米著名投資家バーリ氏の弟子率いるファンド、医療ITのメドレー株強気
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国のシリコンバレーに拠点を置く投資会社、ポメリアム・キャピタルの創業者であるフィル・クリフトン氏は日本株市場にはまだ割安な投資機会が残され、医療IT企業のメドレーなど小型成長株に有望企業があるとみている。

ブルームバーグが入手した29日付の投資家向け書簡の中で明らかにしたものだ。2008年の金融危機を予想し、米住宅市場に対する空売り戦略で利益を上げた著名投資家のマイケル・バーリ氏の下で働いたクリフトン氏は、バーリ氏率いるシオン・アセット・マネジメントが昨年ファンド登録を抹消したことを受け、今年1月にポメリアムを設立した。

書簡によると、クリフトン氏は8月に日本と韓国で20社以上の企業を訪問した。日本株はここ数年にわたるコーポレートガバナンス（企業統治）改革を経て以前ほどの割安感はなくなったが、投資機会は残っていると指摘。同氏が運用するファンドでは現在、ヘルスケア領域の人材派遣やオンライン診療のシステムを手がけるメドレーが最大の投資先になっている。

メドレー経営陣との対話を通じ、同社の成長性は現在の株価が織り込むよりもはるかに大きいとの確信が強まったと説明。さらに、会社側が配当性向を30%とする方針を示したことには現在の株価水準では自社株買いの方が望ましいが、高級ホテルやデータセンターなどに投資するより良いと前向きに評価した。

クリフトン氏は、メドレー以外にも日本には有望な企業が幾つかあると明かし、1社はポジションを現在構築中で、別の1社については株価次第で投資したいとの意向を示した。具体的な社名は公表していない。

一方、韓国に関しては有望な投資機会があるとした半面、超割安に放置された銘柄の多さはガバナンスの問題が大きいと分析。韓国政府主導で取り組む企業改革の成果は出始めているものの、まだ不十分であり、韓国への投資には注意が必要とも見ている。

items.title: DeepSeek joins hands with Huawei to build AI chip software, cutting Nvidia reliance
items.summary: Chinese artificial intelligence developer DeepSeek partnered with Huawei Technologies to create programming tools tailored for Huawei’s Ascend processors, marking an effort by domestic technology ...
items.body:
DeepSeek joins hands with Huawei to build AI chip software, cutting Nvidia reliance Chinese artificial intelligence developer DeepSeek partnered with Huawei Technologies to create programming tools tailored for Huawei’s Ascend processors, marking an effort by domestic technology companies to reduce reliance on the Nvidia ecosystem.
ANI | Updated: 30-09-2026 17:47 IST | Created: 30-09-2026 17:47 IST

Representative image (Photo/DeepSeek X handle). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Chinese artificial intelligence developer DeepSeek partnered with Huawei Technologies to create programming tools tailored for Huawei’s Ascend processors, marking an effort by domestic technology companies to reduce reliance on the Nvidia ecosystem. According to a Reuters news report, the tie-up surfaced as Chinese technology companies pushed to construct domestic alternatives to foreign semiconductor hardware and software. Through a statement published on its official WeChat account, DeepSeek confirmed the release of open-source programming infrastructure for Huawei’s Ascend platform, delivering specialised compute and communication libraries to developers.
The development followed Huawei’s recent unveiling of its next-generation artificial intelligence processors and supernode computing systems, where the hardware maker projected wide adoption of its computing systems for model training in the coming year. As per Reuters, DeepSeek noted that Huawei delivered full technical backing throughout the development of the shared programming infrastructure. The two enterprises jointly progressed a supernode configuration built on 128 Ascend 950 chips, refining computational performance and communication links across the clustered system.
Software efficiency formed a central pillar of the joint effort, with DeepSeek pointing to TileLang, an open-source high-level programming language intended for artificial intelligence chips, as a driver of developer efficiency and streamlined code logic. "To build a new generation of independent, self-controlled GPU software ecosystems, the first priority is establishing a high-level language that is universal, easy to program, and still capable of reaching the hardware's full performance potential," the Reuters news report quoted DeepSeek.
As per the news report, the company stated that existing market alternatives required simpler operational alternatives to maintain competitive software standards. "TileLang was created precisely to meet this need," DeepSeek said.
The group further stated that the language offered "a simpler programming model" than Nvidia’s proprietary CUDA computing platform. (ANI)

items.title: トランプ米大統領、独立機関によるAI監査を支持－安全性巡る姿勢転換
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は29日、AIシステムの安全性評価に外部監査機関を活用することを支持した。AIのリスクに対する懸念が急速に高まる中、シリコンバレーの有力者との合意を通じ、新たな政府規制を導入せずに対応することを目指す。

この合意は29日、ホワイトハウスで開かれた昼食会で、テクノロジー業界の有力幹部約20人との間でまとめられた。合意に基づき、AI企業は定期的に会合を開き、業界のベストプラクティス（最良の運用基準）を策定することも約束した。この文書に法的拘束力はないが、トランプ氏は記者団に「道義的な拘束力がある」と述べた。

「ある意味、憲法のようなものだ」とトランプ氏はイベント後、ホワイトハウスの車寄せで記者団に発言。「世界で最も影響力のある人々が署名し、私も大統領として署名した。これはまさに一種の保護になる」と語った。

AIがもたらす可能性にある壊滅的なリスクへの懸念が世界的に高まる中、トランプ氏と出席者が約2時間にわたって会談後、この合意はまとまった。署名者には、AI業界を代表する開発企業のトップであるアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO、スペースXAIのイーロン・マスク氏を含む。

トランプ氏が自身のSNS「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した文書の写しによると、他にもOpenAIのグレッグ・ブロックマン社長、メタ・プラットフォームズのマーク・ザッカーバーグCEO、グーグルの親会社アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイCEOが署名した。アンソロピックやオープンAIを含む複数の企業はこれまでに、独立した評価機関による検証を受けることを約束している。

トランプ氏はこれまで破滅的な事態への懸念を「でっち上げ」と退けていたが、今回、安全性を巡る議論に応じる姿勢を示した。これは、11月の中間選挙を前にAIが政治的な争点としての色合いを強めていることを反映している。

items.title: 香港のリム、野村HD傘下の杉村倉庫株の保有目的に｢重要提案行為｣追加
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： アクティビスト（物言う株主）として知られるリム・アドバイザーズは、野村ホールディングス傘下の杉村倉庫株の保有目的に「重要提案行為」を追加した。リムが30日に提出した資料で判明した。

リムは発表資料で、杉村倉庫の株価は大幅にディスカウントされている状況にありながら、会社側はノンコア資産売却など資産効率を高めるための施策から目を背けていると指摘。

経営陣との対話を試みたが実現しなかったとして建設的な対話を基軸として、企業価値や株主価値の保全・向上のために重要提案行為などを行う可能性があるとした。リムは杉村倉庫株の6.2％を保有する。

同社株は発表を受けて上昇に転じ、一時前日比6.8%高の993円と2月6日以来の日中上昇率となった。

リムは昨年12月22日の開示資料では、保有目的は純投資としていた。

杉村倉庫の有価証券報告書によると、今年3月末時点では野村ホールディングスが100%子会社である野村プロパティーズによる間接保有分も含めて50.53%を保有する。

杉村倉庫の公式ウェブサイトによると、同社は1895年創業の老舗。本社がある大阪や関東などに倉庫を保有するほか不動産の再開発事業なども手掛けている。

杉村倉庫株を保有する別の香港のファンド、オールド・ピーク・グループも6月、保有目的を従来の純投資から重要提案行為を行うことがあるとの内容に変更している。同社の保有比率は10.22%となっていた。

野村HDはコメントを控えた。杉村倉庫にもコメントを求めたが、現時点では得られていない。

香港のヘッジファンドであるリムはこれまでに日本たばこ産業（JT）やニチイ学館、空港施設など日本企業に対しても株主の立場から経営側に提案した実績がある。

items.title: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike survives execution attempt
items.author: Steve Gorman
items.creator: Steve Gorman
items.summary: Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a schoolmate three decades ago, survived Tennessee's effort to execute her by means of lethal injection late on Wednesday, prison officials said, foiling the state's first attempt to put a woman to death in two centuries.
items.body:
Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a schoolmate three decades ago, survived Tennessee's effort to execute her by means of lethal injection late on Wednesday, prison officials said, foiling the state's first attempt to put a woman to death in two centuries.
Pike's condition following the ordeal was not immediately known, and it was not clear what legal avenues her lawyers or the state might pursue next after she was taken for medical treatment from the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville.
The Tennessee Department of Correction defended its handling of the high-profile execution, which had been opposed by her lawyers and human rights experts due to Pike's age at the time of the crime, her history as the victim of childhood sexual abuse and untreated mental illness.
"The Tennessee Department of Correction followed every step of the state’s lawful, established execution protocol approved by the Attorney General’s Office," the agency said in a statement.
"The lethal injection chemical in the protocol has consistently been effective, and the protocol does not allow for additional procedures beyond what was carried out this evening. Christa Pike has been transported to an off-site medical facility," the statement concluded.
Pike's lawyers filed a federal court motion during the process seeking to halt her execution, citing witnesses' accounts that "executioners had injected both syringes of lethal injection chemicals and Pike is still alive and snoring," NBC News reported.
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee, who denied Pike's clemency petition on Monday, issued a statement after the botched execution, suspending all executions this year and calling for a "comprehensive, third-party review" of Pike's execution attempt, according to the Nashville Tennessean.
The failed execution is the second in Tennessee this year, after prison officials in May [USN:L1N41Y16F TEXT:"aborted attempts to execute a man"] convicted of murders after failing to find a suitable vein for his lethal injection.
The botched attempt on Wednesday came hours after the US Supreme Court lifted an 11th-hour lower-court stay of the execution, clearing the way for Pike, 50, to be put to death for her role in the 1995 torture and beating death of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer in Knoxville.
Pike was 18 in January 1995 when she, 17-year-old boyfriend Tadaryl Shipp and a third companion lured Slemmer, a classmate at their Knoxville Job Corps vocational center, into a wooded area where they tortured and killed her.
The grisly nature of the slaying, which involved the perpetrators carving the shape of a pentagram in the victim's chest and taking a chunk of her skull as a souvenir of the carnage, drew intense media coverage at the time.
Pike and Shipp confessed to the killing, and both were convicted of first-degree murder.
Slemmer's mother, May Martinez, has spoken out in support of the execution.
AMBULANCE CALLED Journalists who witnessed the attempted execution described snoring, loud exhales, gasps and complaints from Pike about discomfort in her arm. At times, the curtain was closed and journalists could only hear sounds.
Clergy were called into the chamber twice, they said, before an ambulance was seen arriving at the prison and then leaving.
Aside from being the first woman the state of Tennessee has tried to execute in more than 200 years, Pike was also poised to became the only person in the modern era of US capital punishment to be executed in Tennessee for a crime committed as a teenager.
In a 226-page petition asking the governor to commute Pike's death penalty to a life sentence without the possibility of parole, her lawyers earlier this week documented her history as the childhood victim of violence, neglect and sexual abuse, including two rapes at ages 11 and 17. They also cited diagnoses she received in prison for bipolar disorder and post-traumatic stress disorder.
Moreover, her lawyers pointed to evidence that Pike's mother drank heavily during pregnancy, contributing to faulty brain development that made it difficult for their client to control her impulses as a young person.
Pike was also convicted in August 2001 of attempted first-degree murder in an assault on another inmate, according to the Correction Department.
Executions of female prison inmates are exceedingly rare in the US, with women accounting for just 18 of the 1,683 people put to death since the Supreme Court allowed capital punishment to resume in 1976, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. Before Wednesday, Tennessee had executed 17 people.

items.title: Iran says it receives US response to latest proposal as Washington pulls out of Iraq
items.author: Ahmed Rasheed, Jana Choukeir, Andrew Mills
items.creator: Ahmed Rasheed, Jana Choukeir, Andrew Mills
items.summary: Iran said it had received a US response to its latest proposal to resurrect the collapsed ceasefire in the Gulf, days after President Donald Trump said he had rejected it.
items.body:
Iran said on Wednesday it had received a US response to its latest proposal to resurrect the collapsed ceasefire in the Gulf, days after President Donald Trump said he had rejected it.
Iran's allies were celebrating on Wednesday after Washington [USN:L6N45M08H TEXT:"withdrew the last of its forces"] from neighbouring Iraq, where 4,500 US troops died in the biggest US war of the century. More than 200,000 Iraqi civilians were killed in chaos unleashed after US forces toppled dictator Saddam Hussein in 2003.
Tehran views the pullout as a victory for its "axis of resistance" of allied armed groups, and a step towards its aim of driving US forces out of the region.
With the US-Israeli war against Iran now entering its eighth month, Iran put forward a proposal last week under which the United States would lift its blockade of Iranian ports and Iran would reopen the disrupted Strait of Hormuz within seven days.
Trump said on Sunday he had rejected the proposal, although Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Tehran had not received a formal rejection. In a post on X on Wednesday, an Iranian government spokesperson said Araqchi had conveyed a US response to the Iranian government.
Iran says its plan aims to restore an interim agreement which collapsed weeks after it was signed by Trump and Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian in June.
Last week, Qatari mediators shuttled between US and Iranian envoys in New York on the sidelines of a meeting of the United Nations, the first proximity talks between the warring sides since the ceasefire unravelled.
An official briefed on the talks, who is not Iranian and spoke to Reuters on condition of anonymity, said the Qataris had briefed Araqchi on the US response on Tuesday when Araqchi stopped off in Doha on his way home from New York. According to the official, the sides largely agree about the steps that are needed but still disagree about the order in which to take them.
Iran wants an eventual deal to grant it control over the Strait of Hormuz, the world's most important oil shipping route, which runs past its coast.
Shipping through the strait has increased in recent weeks, with shippers charging high fees to brave the risk of attacks. But flows of crude oil, refined products and natural gas remain substantially disrupted. In the latest incidents, Britain's UKMTO maritime security body reported on Wednesday that two ships had been hit by projectiles the previous day.
US WITHDRAWAL SEEN IN IRAQ AS DEFEAT FOR WASHINGTON US and Iraqi officials announced the withdrawal of the last American troops from bases in Iraq on Wednesday, fulfilling a plan agreed in 2024 under President Joe Biden and carried out by the Trump administration while it wages war with Iran next door.
The withdrawal was celebrated by Iran and its allies. It marked an "historic victory for the Iraqi Islamic resistance groups and honorable Iraqis, and a crushing defeat for the American project," said Abu Mojtaba al-Yasiri, a commander in the Islamic Resistance in Iraq, an umbrella group of Iran-backed armed factions.
Iraq, which the United States invaded in 2003, has a Shi'ite majority like Iran, and Tehran has established broad political and military influence there.
The country has frequently become a proxy battlefield between the United States and Iran. Of the 18 US service members listed as killed since Trump launched "Operation Epic Fury" in February, seven died in Iraq. Washington blames Iran-backed groups in Iraq for striking neighbouring countries, most recently knocking out a big Saudi oil pipeline three weeks ago.
The US withdrawal raises "the possibility that Iran's proxies will feel increasingly empowered in the absence of a Western military presence," said Baghdad-based political analyst Ahmed Younis. "These groups may attempt to expand their role in shaping state policies and consolidating their presence within key institutions."
At home in the United States, polls show the Iran war was unpopular from the outset. The disruption to global energy supplies and resulting surge in fuel prices have hurt Trump's Republicans, trying to hang on to both houses of Congress in legislative elections five weeks away.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps urged Americans on Tuesday to vote out Trump's allies.
"Remove from power the evil, deceitful, and violent politicians who are responsible for America’s current state," they wrote in a 26-page letter to US voters. "Make sure your politicians understand that the world has changed."
The war has intensified an economic crisis inside Iran, but Tehran has retained the ability to strike its neighbours and menace ships in the strait, where a fifth of global oil transited before the war. Trump says the war will be over soon and Iran will ultimately surrender.
"I don't know if they are going to give up yet but they'll give up," he told reporters on Tuesday. "They are doing very poorly."

items.title: Joy mixed with fear as US forces quit Iraq leaving potential security vacuum
items.author: Ahmed Rasheed, Muayad Hameed, Maher Nazeh
items.creator: Ahmed Rasheed, Muayad Hameed, Maher Nazeh
items.summary: Many Iraqis feared that any security vacuum could increase the power of Iran-backed militias or provide an opening for the return of Islamic State.
items.body:
Iraqis celebrated the departure of US forces after more than two decades of war on Wednesday, though many feared that any security vacuum could increase the power of Iran-backed militias or provide an opening for the return of Islamic State.
The withdrawal of the final troops, mainly from an airbase in Erbil in the semi-autonomous Kurdish region, ended the biggest US war of the century, which brought widespread devastation and chaos from which Iraq has yet to fully emerge.
Iran, which has entrenched its influence in Iraq through allied armed groups and is determined to drive all US forces out of the Middle East, views the US pullout as a triumph for its "axis of resistance" of allied armed groups across the region.
Iraqi troops paraded in vehicles through the streets of Baghdad and the Shi'ite holy city of Najaf to mark the pullout.
The withdrawal "fills our hearts with joy," said Baghdad resident Ahmed Salah, who said he felt reborn at the age of 70. But he also said it was now time for powerful militia groups to surrender their weapons, "and let the government be the one responsible to protect me and you on the ground, sky and water."
The pullout was agreed in 2024 under President Joe Biden and carried out by Donald Trump's administration even as it wages war against Iran next door.
US forces invaded to topple Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein in 2003, triggering years of upheaval and chaos. The Americans initially left at the end of 2011 but came back less than three years later to assist Iraqi forces after [USN:L6N4390KF TEXT:"Islamic State"] fighters seized a third of Iraq and imposed violent rule.
President Donald Trump said that the United States leaves Iraq with "wonderful" Prime Minister Ali Faleh al-Zaidi, saying in a Truth Social post that he would "hopefully be able to handle things very well."
More than 4,500 US troops died in Iraq, around twice as many as in the parallel war in Afghanistan. The Iraq Body Count project says more than 200,000 Iraqi civilians were killed.
The Pentagon said the United States and its coalition partners formally concluded "Operation Inherent Resolve" and Washington would continue to provide targeted training and intelligence support to Iraqi partners.
The Iraqis are expected to lead the effort to secure the country, an ally of both Washington and Tehran, and keep the remnants of Islamic State suppressed.
“The end of the international coalition’s mission does not mean the end of our battle against terrorism, but rather Iraq’s transition to a phase in which it assumes full responsibility for its security and stability," said Zaidi in a statement.
'SECURITY VACUUMS CAN BE EXTREMELY DANGEROUS' While the departure of US forces is broadly popular among Iraqis, some worry that security forces trained and funded by the United States still can't protect the country.
"The lesson from the past two decades is that security vacuums can be extremely dangerous," said Jassim al-Bahadli, an Iraqi analyst who advises the security forces.
Adil Salman, 45, a high school English teacher, said Iraqis "should not rush to celebrate" the withdrawal.
"Militias still operate outside the state's control and (Islamic State) still has not disappeared," he said. "I'm concerned that the US departure could lead to a new period of instability. In the end, people will judge this decision by one thing: whether security remains stable in the coming years."
Hundreds of supporters of pro-Iranian Iraqi militia groups gathered in Baghdad to celebrate the pullout, chanting "Death to America".
They carried portraits of Iran's slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, his son Mojtaba, who succeeded him, and top Iranian General Qassem Soleimani, who was killed in a US airstrike on his convoy in Baghdad in 2020.
With US forces present alongside armed groups allied to Iran, Iraq has been caught up in this year's war.
Of the 18 US service members listed as killed since Trump launched "Operation Epic Fury" alongside Israel in February, seven died in Iraq. The last was an army sergeant who died during the controlled detonation of a drone at a base near Erbil in July.
The withdrawal raises "the possibility that Iran's proxies will feel increasingly empowered in the absence of a Western military presence. These groups may attempt to expand their role in shaping state policies and consolidating their presence within key institutions," said Baghdad-based political analyst Ahmed Younis.
Some Iraqi security officials say the US pullout also risks giving new life to Islamic State fighters, who, despite the defeat of their self-proclaimed caliphate nearly a decade ago, retain a sleeper cell network.
The last time the US withdrew, the Iraqi army proved no match for Islamic State: soldiers took off their uniforms and fled when the group captured Mosul, Iraq's second-largest city, in 2014.
"The most important question now is whether Iraq's security institutions have prepared a viable Plan B for the post-coalition phase," said retired Iraqi Army General Mohammed al-Jubouri, who led a brigade in the war against Islamic State.

items.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight lands in Saudi after emergency; hijacking ruled out
items.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv landed in Saudi Arabia after an emergency was declared mid-air; Israeli officials later said the incident was not believed to be a hijacking ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Dubai-Tel Aviv flight lands in Saudi after emergency; hijacking ruled out

Dubai-Tel Aviv flight lands in Saudi after emergency; hijacking ruled out A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv landed in Saudi Arabia after an emergency was declared mid-air; Israeli officials later said the incident was not believed to be a hijacking

The Flydubai FZ1073 flight, carrying over 100 passengers, was travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv when it declared an emergency. (Photo: Wikipedia)

Rimjhim Singh New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Sep 30 2026 | 4:49 PM IST

Listen to This Article

The Israeli government believes an incident ??on a flight from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, which diverted to Saudi Arabia after transmitting emergency signals on Wednesday, may have been an attempted "terror attack" by one of the pilots, according to two Israeli officials.  
The two Israeli officials said the co-pilot was believed to have stabbed the captain before cabin crew entered the cockpit and took control of the plane. An Israeli official had earlier told Reuters the plane transmitted the emergency signals after the pilots got into a physical altercation with each other.
  Around the time the plane landed in Saudi Arabia, Doron Spielman, a spokesperson for the Israeli prime minister's office, told Reuters the incident was not believed to have been a hijacking, describing it as a "different incident".
 

  He did not immediately respond to a further request for comment on whether Israel was treating it as terror incident.
  The two officials, speaking on the condition of anonymity to brief reporters, said Israel's current assessment is that the incident was an attempted "terror attack" and not related to any kind of mental health issue with either of the pilots.
Also Read

flydubai co-pilot stabs captain onboard: Here's what we know so far

Private capex outlook is rising, but what is driving project distress now?

Paid for a house, lived there but HC nixes son's ownership plea: Here's why

India may get multiple TV ratings agencies: But which TRP will count?

EC withdraws SIR declaration from Form 6: Here's what it means

Flight plummeted before steadying again, tracking data shows In a video purportedly of an Israeli passenger on board the flydubai flight and carried widely by Israeli media, the passenger said one of pilots was seriously injured and the other was slightly injured, after one of the pilots was stabbed.

  Saudi Arabia's Tabuk airport, where the plane eventually landed safely, said that both pilots had been hospitalised after sustaining injuries. Neither the airport or the purported Israeli passenger identified the attacker.
  Flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia as it flew over Jordanian airspace, transmitting a general emergency signal and then another emergency signal that indicated possible unlawful interference, according to flight-tracking website Flightradar24.
  The Boeing 737 plane, which Israeli media said had around 150 Israeli passengers on board, then again transmitted the initial general emergency signal before later landing at Tabuk airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, the website said.

  The aircraft's data appeared to show that it had suddenly and rapidly descended by nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds before the first emergency signal, Flightradar24 said. It was not immediately clear who transmitted the emergency signals.
Conflicting reports appear in media, Israel holds security consultations Israeli media published conflicting reports on the incident, with some outlets reporting that a pilot had tried to crash the passenger plane in an alleged attempted suicide attempt. Some Israeli media outlets identified the pilots as Omani and Emirati nationals, while others said they were Russian and Ukrainian.
  The incident triggered a national security consultations in Israel, which has no official diplomatic relations with Saudi Arabia, where the plane landed.

  In a statement, the Israeli prime minister's office said the situation was "under control" and that all measures were being taken to bring the Israeli passengers back to ??Israel.
  Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who earlier held security consultations on the incident, has cleared his schedule for the rest of the day to manage the crisis, an Israeli official said.
  Netanyahu on Sunday met with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan during a a rare visit to the Gulf country. Israel and the UAE have forged close security, military and economic ties since establishing diplomatic ties in 2020.
  Earlier this year, Israel provided the UAE with Iron Dome air-defence systems and Israeli personnel to operate them, helping defend against Iranian attacks launched in retaliation for Israeli and US strikes on Iran.  

The UAE is yet to comment on the incident, while the Dubai-owned airline has only said that the flight experienced an "incident" and diverted to Tabuk, where it landed safely, and that all passengers were safe and accounted for.
Passenger reportedly witnessed pilot forced to the floor by man holding a knife Yasmin Abukasis said her daughter Miriam, who was among the passengers on the flight, had told her that she had heard screaming and that a man holding a knife had forced one of the pilots onto the floor, and that there was blood everywhere.  
Israeli media published a photo purportedly taken from inside the plane, which appeared to show a passenger's blood-soaked shirt. Reuters could not immediately verify the image.

  Flydubai operates daily return flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv, a route that is popular among Israeli nationals. The flight path normally uses airspace over Saudi Arabia and Jordan.
  It is not the first time a flight between Israel and the UAE has landed in Saudi Arabia. A flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv made an emergency landing in Riyadh in September 2025 due to a medical incident, Israeli media reported at the time.
